name: adamson/video-scrub
title: Video scrub
description: A video that plays forwards and backwards as the visitor scrolls. Upload a scrub-ready MP4 (a keyframe every 1–5 frames).

fields.label: Video (desktop)
fields.help: MP4, H.264, no audio, keyframe every 1–5 frames, fast start.

fields.label: Video fallback (MP4, optional)
fields.help: For browsers that can't play the main video, e.g. when the main video is a transparent WebM.

fields.label: Poster image
fields.help: Shown before the video loads and to visitors who turned off motion.
